notes.title: v1.1.12 Update + Price Drop
notes.notes:
[h2]Blast Rush Classic 1.1.12 is now available.[/h2][h3]Details:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with triggering Manual Hyperdodge after it was activated.[/p][/*][*][p]Swapped Confirm/Cancel on the keyboard mapping from Z/X to X/Z.[/p][/*][*][p]Control remappings are now saved to the system registry (i.e., not to cloud).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the How To Play scene's display on ultrawide resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor graphics tweaks.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]New Price for Blast Rush Classic[/h2][p][b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3629840"]Blast Rush LS is out now[/url][/b], and includes the original Blast Rush in "Classic" mode. Given that, we're dropping Blast Rush Classic's base price to USD $0.99 (and international equivalents) from here on. [/p][p]We encourage everyone who has Blast Rush Classic to give Blast Rush LS a try -- you can download the BRLS Demo to sample what's new and improved, and wishlist or purchase if you like what you see![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your support,[/p][p]Your Friends at BDog
([url="https://bsky.app/profile/bipedal.dog"]Follow on Bluesky![/url])[/p]
